stories.title: Netanyahu orders West Bank lockdown after shooting wounds five Israelis
stories.line: Israel is preparing a full closure of the occupied West Bank after a shooting attack that wounded five Israelis, with an election days away.

stories.title: ACA open enrollment starts with the window for picking a 2026 health plan
stories.line: Enhanced ACA subsidies have expired for many enrollees, so 2026 open enrollment means higher premiums for a lot of people shopping for coverage.

stories.title: Ebola spreads to Kenya and Nigeria, with no approved vaccine for this strain
stories.line: Ebola, a strain with no approved vaccine or treatment, is spreading to Kenya and Nigeria beyond the Congo outbreak, with thousands of cases already recorded.

Greece bans social media for children under 15 starting January 2027
stories.line: Greece passed a law banning social media for children under 15, effective January 1, 2027, citing mental health and addiction.

stories.title: US reportedly plans new Iran strikes, prepares for long standoff
stories.line: US officials reportedly plan fresh strikes on Iran and are preparing for a prolonged standoff, raising the risk of wider war.

stories.title: Gen Z protests spread across Albania, Italy, France and India over fairness
stories.line: Young people in Albania, Italy, France and India are protesting over economic fairness, a grievance shared across very different countries.

stories.title: Taxes due tomorrow: how to request a filing extension
stories.line: Federal income tax returns are due tomorrow, and people who need more time can request an extension.

stories.title: Medicaid ends for hundreds of thousands of lawful immigrants, including refugees
stories.line: Hundreds of thousands of lawfully present immigrants, including refugees and trafficking victims, lost Medicaid eligibility under a federal law change effective Oct. 1.

stories.title: Macron to meet student groups as France braces for more school protests
stories.line: French students are protesting underfunded schools and teacher shortages, and Macron meets their representatives Friday as bans and curfews take effect.
